normalization: each endpoint count and frequency divided by its corresponding matched ungated-input value; Raw = 1 for both metrics

frequency_definitions.live_cd45: percentage of Live cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.b_cells: percentage of Live CD45+ cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.t_cells: percentage of Live CD45+ cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.nkt_cells: percentage of Live CD45+ cells before matched-Raw normalization

matched_ungated_inputs.time: Nadia singlet + debris masks, without a time mask
matched_ungated_inputs.debris: Nadia time + doublet masks, without a debris mask
matched_ungated_inputs.doublet: Nadia time + debris masks, without a doublet mask
matched_ungated_inputs.all steps: no time, debris, or doublet preprocessing mask

nkt_exclusion: sample 15A excluded from every NKT summary and statistical test
